title: Recursive Boolean circuit search state
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, and for each natural number $j$ let $D_j$ be a directed acyclic Boolean circuit with $n+j$ input vertices. Define $S_0$ to be the pair consisting of the single true constant gate and the empty list of indices. Recursively, if $S_j=(G,I)$, form a circuit gate list from $D_{j+1}$ by mapping each argument $v$ to the $(v+1)$st entry of the list formed by concatenating $0,1,\ldots,n-1$, the entries of $I$, and $n$ when $v<n$, and to $n+|G|+(v-n)$ otherwise; remove repeated arguments from each mapped gate, then append an AND gate whose sole argument is the mapped output of $D_{j+1}$. The state $S_{j+1}$ is the pair whose first list is $G$ followed by this constructed gate list, and whose second list is $I$ followed by the index $n+|G|+|\mathrm{gates}(D_{j+1})|$.
hypotheses_covered: For each natural number $j$, a directed acyclic Boolean circuit $D_j$ with $n+j$ input vertices.
